links.outcome: Linguistic accuracy of AI Spanish translations rated by native-speaking nephrologists (1-5)
links.effect: Mean linguistic accuracy 4.89 ± 0.32 for GPT-3.5 and 5.00 ± 0.00 for GPT-4.0 (p = 0.08); excellent translations 89% vs 100% (p = 0.24).
links.quote: The mean linguistic accuracy scores were 4.89 ± 0.32 for GPT-3.5 and 5.00 ± 0.00 for GPT-4.0 (p = 0.08).

unlisted_practices: Native-speaker clinician rubric review of LLM translations of patient education content for accuracy and cultural sensitivity

screen.reason: Evaluates the accuracy and cultural sensitivity of ChatGPT (3.5 vs 4.0) translations of kidney donor FAQs by having nephrologists rate them offline, without evaluating an organizational deployment practice or guardrail intervention.
